issues.problem: pt-gachi: 太り気味 glossed 'putting on weight'; it means 'a bit overweight'.
pt-ippou: explain claimed none of the three works with an activity verb, but dictionary form + ばかりだ with an activity verb is the common 'does nothing but' use (泣くばかりだ).
issues.action: Restricted the change-verb rule to this sense and added the 'does nothing but' reading of ばかりだ.

issues.problem: pt-zaruwoenai mistake: 約束したから、行くわけにはいかない is not wrong ('I promised (someone), so I can't go').
issues.action: Made the bad sentence self-contradictory: 行くと約束したから、行くわけにはいかない -> 行かないわけにはいかない.

issues.problem: pt-kanenai mistake: 読みがたい is attested (判読しがたい, literary 読みがたい), so the 'bad' sentence was not clearly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced with the textbook case このペンは書きがたい -> 書きにくい and adjusted the note.

issues.problem: pt-kanenai tip covered only かねない/かねる, leaving 得る and がたい without a quick test.
issues.action: Rewrote the tip as a four-way one-word check.
